briefs.title: Fernlight Sync 3.0 launch brief
lines: Fernlight Sync 3.0 goes live on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 9:00 Pacific.
Sync every file across every device, with no manual steps.
Fernlight Sync Pro is 12 dollars per user per month, billed annually.
New teams get a free trial before the first invoice.
IT leads at companies with 50 to 500 employees.
Email to the existing customer list, a webinar on launch day, and paid search.

threads.text: Move the launch to Tuesday, November 3, so it lines up with the webinar.
Change the headline to: The fastest file sync on the market.
Trial length is 14 days - please write it into the line.
Add a co-marketing post with our reseller Tallgrass Systems on launch day.

briefs.title: Orchard & Pine autumn cider campaign brief
lines: The orchard at dawn, mist over the rows, no people and no animals.
Six social posts, two outdoor boards and a shelf talker; final files as PNG.
Lena Ortiz, brand director, signs off on every piece.

threads.text: End the campaign on October 25, not November 1 - the batch sells out by then.
Put the fox mascot in the hero image, sitting under the first tree.
Swap deep green for navy so it matches the new bottle labels.
Raise the budget to 60,000 dollars to add a third outdoor board.
Please send layered PSD files along with the PNGs for every final.

briefs.title: Brightline Dental refer-a-friend brief
lines: Each patient who refers a friend gets a free at-home whitening kit.
In-clinic posters and a text message to current patients.
Artwork to the clinic by November 12, 2026.
Warm and plain-spoken; no before-and-after photos.
